A '''dataplan''' was a storage medium of parts of an overall design. [[Gizor Dellso]], a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] stalwart, held [[Thief/Legends|stolen]] dataplans for an experimental [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] some [[Time/Legends|time]] after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|gizordellso|Dellso, Gizor}}</ref>
